record_type_quote: In this study, we replicated and extended Stinson and Dallery (2023) by evaluating the effects of a contingency management with alternative activity selection intervention on SMU and engagement in alternative activities with four college students.

targets.title: Reducing problematic social media use via a package intervention
targets.evidence_quote: In this study, we replicated and extended Stinson and Dallery (2023) by evaluating the effects of a contingency management with alternative activity selection intervention on SMU and engagement in alternative activities with four college students.
targets.outcome_quote: Results from the current study replicate the findings of Stinson and Dallery.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict confirms the findings; reduced social media use and unchanged alternative activity engagement match the target.

reasoning: Four newly recruited students test the prior intervention finding. Stanley et al. and other intervention reports motivate the work but are not directly retested. Full article title, four authors, methods, discussion and reference list verified.
